topics: Basic Concepts of Data Structures: Algorithms, Performance Analysis, Space Complexity, Time Complexity, Asymptotic Notations
Arrays:  Linear Search and Binary Search
Linked List: Self-Referential Structures, Dynamic Memory Allocation
Singly Linked List- Operations on Linked List
Stacks and Queues using Linked List
Binary Search Trees- Binary Search Tree Operations
Depth First Search and Breadth First Search on Graphs
Sorting and Hashing: Sorting Techniques – Selection Sort

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Compare performance of algorithms using  asymptotic notations
Solve real world problems efficiently using appropriate data structures like arrays, linked list, stacks and queues.
Make use of nonlinear data structures like trees and graphs to design algorithms for various applications.
Apply and compare various techniques for searching and sorting.
Apply appropriate hash function to store and access a given dataset
